title: SmtpRelayConfig.peer_down_secs validation missing in reader
description: SmtpRelayConfig in reader/src/config.rs has peer_down_secs with default 300, but Config::validate() in reader/src/config.rs does not check this value. A zero value for peer_down_secs would mean peers are never marked down (Duration::from_secs(0) = instant recovery), producing tight retry loops. The smtp crate's delivery.smtp_peer_down_secs similarly has no zero check. Neither location validates that the retry interval is sane. This will generate confusing support requests when an operator sets peer_down_secs = 0 expecting it to mean 'always retry' and instead gets hammering.
